Zich Moore, the fearsome Demon Lord, is struck down by the hero Glen Zenard. As he dies, he hears Glen's request: for him to be a good person if he is ever reborn. 

Miraculously, Zich awakens in the body of his younger self and resolves to be a better individual. But the problem is... he has no idea what it means to be good! 

Can the former Demon Lord truly learn what it means to be kind? Or will his old habits and misconceptions about virtue and goodness make redemption difficult?

The car accident happened right in front of him, and from that day on wards, he lived the life of a hopeless nut job. Hyunwoo's mother, who's on the verge of giving up, decides to set him up for a blind date. Things happen and Hyunwoo agrees to meet the woman his mother set him up with. Her name is Jimin and she turns out to be a dead ringer for Jihye. Rattled, Hyunwoo gets drunk and keeps on overlapping Jihye's image with Jimin's. Until finally, in his confusion, he kisses Jimin. Will Hyunwoo realize Jimin's deepest secret? What will happen if he finds out about it?

description.en:
A sword was pointed at Diana’s neck. It was a rather pathetic end for a female knight who once swept through the battlefield.

“I’ll never wield a sword again…”

Diana exhaled her last breath. With a chilling sound, the blade fell downward. She thought everything had ended that way. But… everything was reversed.

At the age of 10, before she had ever held a sword, Diana made a decision.

---
Diana Lesley, a renowned knight of the Agripana Kingdom, is killed by her rival Cornelius Heimann in the war against the Heverunia Empire. However, when she wakes up, she finds herself at 10 years old and decides to pursue the life of a proper lady instead of a knight—much to her family's disapproval. After becoming Princess Juliana's lady-in-waiting, she must contend with conniving noblewomen, the threat of oncoming war, and the affections of Cornelius who, in this life, dreams about her past life and falls for her. Can she keep her loved ones safe and live in peace?
description.id: Sebuah pedang diarahkan ke leher Diana. Itu adalah akhir yang agak menyedihkan bagi seorang ksatria wanita yang pernah melintasi medan perang. “Aku tidak akan pernah menggunakan pedang lagi…” Diana menghembuskan nafas terakhirnya. Dengan suara dingin, bilahnya jatuh ke bawah. Dia pikir semuanya berakhir seperti itu. Tapi… semuanya terbalik. Pada usia 10 tahun, sebelum dia memegang pedang, Diana telah membuat keputusan.

When he unexpectedly wins 1.8 billion won in the lottery, he believes he’s finally found an escape, but family troubles and a brand new outlook on life lead him back to the office where he and his unlikely team of underdogs battle the odds to succeed.

description.en:
When I opened my eyes, I was inside a fantasy novel world!

The beauty I see in front of the mirror is the future tyrant’s older sister, Alicia! She’s not even a protagonist or an antagonist, but a character that doesn’t appear much and gets beheaded by the (upcoming) tyrant little brother.

My life is all about escaping that fate from the novel. In the end, I seduced the male lead’s merchant friend who also doesn’t appear much and was about to leave the country with him.

How-e-ver. The face of the man who spent the night with me was extraordinary.

“I-I’m pretty sure the name I heard yesterday wasn’t that name but something else. Uhm, what was it. I-I think it’s Sir Lancelot.”

“Ah, that’s my friend.”

“…”

“Why, is there a problem?”

Excuse me, you’re asking if there’s a problem? A lot. There’s a lot. Why is the male lead on my bed!

How can her one-night stand be her student's guardian? Amelie escaped her life as an abused housemaid and became the youngest professor at the Royal Academy. When a prophecy reveals that the person she marries will die an untimely death, she decides to spend a passionate night with a handsome stranger before succumbing to her destiny. However, she is shocked when she comes face to face with her one-night stand again, for not only is he her student's guardian, but he's an unrelenting duke who will stop at nothing to win her over. Will the star-crossed lovers beat destiny and find their happily ever after?

description.en:
I opened my eyes to find myself in an unfamiliar place. In the midst of confusion, the only thing I could rely on was my phone. To recover my memories and return, I had to raise the affection levels of the targets and see a special ending.

So, I worked hard to interact with the targets, raising their affection levels one by one. It seemed to be going smoothly — until a new notification arrived.

『Each target’s affection level is capped at 5. If it reaches 6 or more, an “overheat” state will be triggered, greatly increasing the likelihood of an extreme ending.』

"Just now… how many hearts were there?" As I tried to check the system window, I heard approaching footsteps.

『A target is nearby.』

I had to escape immediately. But…

『▷ Affection level towards you: ♥♥♥♥ (They like you. They will try to find you no matter where you are.)』
___
I woke up in a strange place, with only a phone to guide me. To recover my memories and return home, I had to raise my targets’ affection levels and unlock a special ending. But once a target has over five hearts, it triggers overheat—and a dangerous, unhinged ending awaits. It's a delicate balance!
description.fr:
À mon réveil, je me suis retrouvée dans un lieu inconnu.
Mon seul repère dans ce chaos était mon téléphone portable.

Pour retrouver mes souvenirs et rentrer chez moi, je dois accumuler des points d’affection auprès des personnages cibles et atteindre une fin spéciale.

J’ai donc commencé à interagir avec eux et à remplir peu à peu leurs jauges d’affection. Tout semblait se dérouler sans encombre... Jusqu’à l’arrivée d’une nouvelle notification.

« Le nombre maximum de points d’affection par cible est de 5.
Au-delà de 6, l’état 'Overheat' (surchauffe) s’active, augmentant drastiquement le risque de déboucher sur une fin tragique. »

'Tout à l’heure… il avait combien de cœurs déjà ?'

Alors que j’essayais de vérifier la fenêtre du système, des bruits de pas se rapprochèrent.

« Un personnage cible se trouve à proximité. »

Je voulais fuir immédiatement. Mais…

▷ Points d’affection à votre égard : ♥♥♡♥♡♥♡♥
(Ils sont amoureux de vous. Où que vous soyez, ils feront tout pour vous retrouver.)
description.ko: 눈을 떠보니 모르는 곳이었다. 혼란스러운 가운데 이정표가 될 것은 휴대폰 뿐. 기억을 찾아 돌아가기 위해선 공략 대상들의 호감도를 채우고 특별한 엔딩을 봐야 한다. 그래서 열심히 공략 대상들과 엮였고, 호감도를 하나 둘 채웠다. 얼핏 순조로운 듯했다. 새로운 알림이 오기 전까진. 『공략 대상에게 할당된 호감도는 5개까지입니다. 6개부터는 '오버히트(overheat:과열)' 상태로, 극단적인 엔딩을 마주할 확률이 매우 높아집니다.』 ‘아까…… 하트가 몇 개였지?’ 시스템 창을 확인하려던 순간에 발소리가 접근했다. 『공략 대상이 근처에 있습니다.』 지금이라도 도망쳐야 했다. 하지만……
description.ru:
Открыв глаза, я обнаружила себя в незнакомом месте. Посреди всей этой суматохи единственной вещью, на которую я могла положиться, был мой телефон. Чтобы восстановить свою память и вернуться, мне нужно было повысить уровень чувств целей и достичь особой концовки.

Поэтому я старательно взаимодействовала с целями, повышая их уровни чувств один за другим. Казалось, всё идёт гладко — до тех пор, пока не пришло новое уведомление.

"Уровень чувств каждой цели ограничен 5. Если достигнете 6-го и выше, будет запущено состояние «перегрева», что значительно увеличит вероятность получения экстремальной концовки."

— Сколько там... Только что было сердец?

Я услышала приближающиеся шаги, пока пыталась проверить системное окно.

"Цель неподалёку."

Мне нужно было незамедлительно сбежать. Но...

"Уровень чувств к вам: ♥♥♥♥ (Вы ему нравитесь. Он будет пытаться найти вас, где бы вы ни были)."

description.en:
A reclusive, disfigured man stalks a pretty, good-natured housewife. One day, he witnesses this woman's daughter being kidnapped.  
  
 [Official Chinese](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/drama/wozaikanzheni/list?title_no=786&page=1)

Yeon Hwicheon from the Yeon Clan is deceived by the Dam Clan, who is after his Sect’s Divine Treasures, into an arranged marriage.
Despite the unsightly scar on his face, he meets his kind-hearted wife, Dam Hwayeon, and they live a trouble-free life. However, the Dam Clan, revealing their true intentions, causes the downfall of the Yeon Clan.
Hwicheon then barely escapes and finds refuge in a cave. Here, he has a fateful encounter, through which he acquires advanced martial arts skills. Suddenly he finds himself traveling back in time to the moment right after his marriage 15 years prior.
Knowing in advance the wicked acts the Dam Clan will commit, Yeon Hwicheon preemptively exacts a fierce revenge, finally causing its extinction.
With his incredible martial arts skills, Yeon Hwicheon and the now stronger Yeon Clan quickly become the targets of the martial arts world and Hwicheon, already anticipating this, further elevates the martial arts of the his Clan and boldly throws down a challenge to the entire martial arts community under his name!

Sungha is loved by men and women of all ages for his mature and kind character. But he has scars that can’t be shown to just anyone… Woojoo is the only friend he can open up to. The day after the final exam, Sungha gathers the courage to overcome his wounds and try to change. This is the story of Sungha and Woojoo healing each other.

Blue Dragon, Red Phoenix, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise.  
To stop the sacred spirits of the Heavenly Realm wreaking havoc in the world of humans, successors of the Four Deities are born in each generation to guard the barrier with the Heavenly Realm, using the powers of the four sacred spirits. And the place they gather to train before they ascend to heaven is Doonggule, a traditional tea house in a small country town.
I found myself trapped in the game I created. However, in order to escape, I need to unlock a hidden ending that even I am not aware of…

But instead of death, he awakens to a new life with soft, frail hands and the title of the third son of House Valdek, the most powerful family in the empire, rivaling even the crown. Surrounded by wealth and splendor, Jake realizes he has been granted a second chance to fulfill his ambition. So he sets off, determined to rise as high as possible. 

Look out, world, here comes Lucian Valdek!

description.en:
Laviore Bailey — the ‘fake saintess’ who banished the innocent princess and stirred up bad blood to wage war.

She’s the villainess with a façade of a saintess.

“I love you. So just shut your mouth and die. Okay?”

But the moment her trusted lover chose her as a sacrifice to the demon, and she realized her father was behind the plan, she killed herself by swallowing poison. It hurt. It was so painful that she could not even scream. But it was fine. Because she knew this was not the end.

“I will save you this time.”

Then, she came back for her second life. She was determined to rescue those who were unlucky because of her and restored her life back.

“You do whatever you want for the man in your dream.” Demian said with a rough smile. 

“I’ll also protect you the way I want to.”

---
Laviore Rea Bailey, the fake saint and heartless puppet of the merciless Prince Sidar, drinks poison on the day the prince is to give her up as an offering to the devil. Instead of dying, she wakes up 10 years in the past. Set on righting her previous wrongs, Laviore vows to save the slave Damian Rhode Drake, whom she had once framed as a spy. As she gets closer to the mysterious Damian, new feelings start to emerge, but will this former villainess truly be able to change her ways?
description.fr:
Laviore Bailey, la «fausse sainte» qui a banni la princesse innocente et attisé le sang-froid pour faire la guerre.

«Je t'aime. Alors ferme ta bouche et meurs. D'accord?»

Mais au moment où son amant de confiance l'a choisie comme sacrifice au démon et qu'elle réalise que son père est derrière le plan, elle se suicide en avalant du poison.

Ça fait mal. C'est si douloureux qu'elle ne peut même pas crier. Mais c'est bien, car elle a échappée au sacrifice.

«Je vais vous sauver cette fois.»

Puis elle est revenue pour sa seconde vie. Elle est déterminée à sauver ceux qui n'ont pas eu de chance à cause d'elle.
description.id: Laviore Bailey—'Saintess palsu' yang mengusir putri tak berdosa dan mengobarkan darah buruk untuk berperang. Dia adalah penjahat dengan penampilan seperti saintess. "Aku mencintaimu. Jadi tutup saja mulutmu dan mati. Oke?" Tapi saat kekasihnya yang terpercaya memilihnya sebagai korban iblis, dan dia menyadari ayahnya berada di balik rencana tersebut, dia bunuh diri dengan menelan racun. Sakit. Sangat menyakitkan hingga dia bahkan tidak bisa berteriak. Tapi bukan masalah. Karena dia tahu ini bukanlah akhir. “Aku akan menyelamatkanmu kali ini.” Kemudian, dia kembali untuk kehidupan keduanya. Dia bertekad untuk menyelamatkan mereka yang tidak beruntung karenanya dan memulihkan hidupnya kembali. “Lakukan apapun yang kau inginkan untuk pria dalam mimpimu.” Ucap Demian sambil tersenyum kasar. “Aku juga akan melindungimu sesuai keinginanku.”
description.ko:
오트안의 가짜 성녀, '라비오르 리아 베일리'
연인의 배신으로 악마의 제물로 바쳐지는 것이 결정된 날,
모든 걸 되돌려 바로잡을 기회를 주겠다는 신의 목소리를 듣게 된다.

"뭐든지 할게요. 시간을 되돌릴 수 있다면…!"

찰나의 망설임도 없이 돌아온 두 번째 삶.

라라는 자신만의 방식으로 하나둘 이전 삶의 과오를 청산해나가지만
'데미안 로드 드레이크', 저로 인해 불행을 겪은 남자를
행복하게 해주겠다는 계획만은 도무지 뜻대로 풀리지 않는다.

"나 정도면 제법 자랑할 만한 노예 아닌가?
앞으로 6개월 동안 내 마스터 레이디가 되는 건 어때."

노예의 신분에서 자유롭게 해주겠다는 제안도 거절,

"제가 원하는 건 마스터 레이디께서 다 해주십니다.
그러니 포상은 제 마스터 레이디께만 해주십시오."

왕족의 포상을 받을 뻔했던 기회도 무산.

번번이 제 예상을 빗나가는 남자가
허를 찌르는 한 마디를 던진 순간,

"라라, 나는 성녀를 찾고있어."

라라의 운명은 또 한 번 움직이기 시작하는데…
description.uk:
Лавіора Бейлі - "фальшива свята," яка вигнала невинну принцесу і розпалила ворожнечу, щоб розв'язати війну.

Вона - лиходійка з обличчям святої.

"Я люблю тебе. Тож просто закрий рота і помри. Гаразд?"

Але в ту мить, коли її вірний коханий обрав її в жертву демону, і вона зрозуміла, що за цим планом стоїть її батько, вона вбила себе, проковтнувши отруту.

Це було боляче. Було так боляче, що вона не могла навіть крикнути. Але це було добре. Бо вона знала, що це не кінець.

"Цього разу я тебе врятую."

Потім вона повернулася до свого другого життя. Вона була сповнена рішучості рятувати тих, кому не пощастило через неї, і повернути своє життя назад.

"Роби все, що хочеш для чоловіка зі свого сну," - сказав Деміан з усмішкою на вустах.

"Я також буду захищати тебе так, як захочу."

"Tu hermano gemelo está muerto. Estás a punto de ser Esper".  
  
Kyle, que solía trabajar a tiempo parcial en un café, se enamoró de Lou, el cliente que venía frecuentemente al café y que un día lo invitó a su casa.   
Pero Lou era un corredor ilegal de Esper que trabajaba junto al hermano gemelo de Kyle: Ray.   
Lou mantiene a Kyle encerrado en su casa, advirtiendo que Kyle expresaría el catastrófico ESP debido a la muerte de su hermano.   
Kyle sufre un repentino estallido de manifestación, pero cuanto más toca a Lou… ¿Es menos doloroso?  
  
"Es extraño … es porque Lou me toca… creo que es menos doloroso".

description.en:
Everyone adored my stepsister, Loena. And I, her elder sister Siché, hated her.

“Loena. I really hate you.”

After losing everything, Siché left behind those final words and ended her life before Loena’s eyes.

That should have been the end...

“My name is Loena. Are we going to be family now?”

Life began to repeat itself. Cruelly, hopelessly so.
description.fr: La demi-sœur bien-aimée, Roena. Et sa demi-sœur, Sise, qui la détestait. « Roena. Je te déteste vraiment. » Ayant tout perdu, Sise laissa ces mots derrière elle et mit fin à ses jours juste devant les yeux de Roena. Cela aurait dû être la fin… « Je m’appelle Roena. Sommes-nous une famille maintenant ? » La vie a commencé à se répéter. Terriblement, désespérément.
description.ko:
모두에게 사랑받는 의붓동생 로에나.
그녀를 증오한 새 언니 시스에.

"로에나. 난 네가 정말 싫어."

모든 것을 잃은 시스에는
그 말을 남기고 로에나의 눈앞에서 삶을 끝마친다.

분명 그랬는데.…

“로에나라고 해요. 이제 우리는 가족이 되는 건가요?”

삶이 다시 되풀이되었다.
지독히 절망스럽게도.
description.pl: Rowena, przyrodnia siostra uwielbiana przez wszystkich. I Siche, nowa najstarsza córka hrabiego, która żywiła do niej wyłącznie nienawiść. „Rowena, naprawdę cię nienawidzę” – oświadczyła Siche, a jej głos był pełen bólu. Straciwszy wszystko, odebrała sobie życie na oczach Roweny. Tak właśnie było, a przynajmniej tak się wydawało...
description.ru:
Всеми любимая сводная сестра Ровена.
И ненавидящая её старшая сестра Исис.

— Ровена, я всей душой тебя ненавижу. - Напоследок произнесла, потерявшая всё, Исис и покончила с жизнью.

Однако...

— Меня зовут Ровена. Теперь мы станем семьёй?

Всё повторилось.
Какое разочарование.

description.en:
Becky was sold to the Grand Duchy of Bernum due to the financial downfall of her family. It is a hopeless situation, but she is not upset about this development. Mostly because she reincarnated with memories of her past life.

And there, Becky meets a dazzlingly beautiful but somewhat feisty girl.

“I-I am B-Becky Harvina.”
“It’s my first time getting a human as a toy, so what can you do?”

It was Liande, the heir to the Grand Duchy and her new owner. Becky, after becoming the best of friends with her, realized that she is curt but strangely kind.

But surprisingly, Liande’s gender is actually male. He disguised himself as a woman to take the place of his dead sister. He is taking on the position of a new successor, which is inherited only by women.

He couldn’t open his heart to anyone because of the great secret he had. As the days pass he is getting more and more affectionate with Becky, who is bright and honest…

“…what if I were a man? So what do you think of it?”

The deeper their feelings get, the closer they get to each other, and the more they might avoid the unfortunate future they may have. Will they ever have a happy ending?

description.en:
After waking up in the middle of the woods, on a rainy night, and in the body of a novel's villainess, Ophelia Lizen just wants one thing... a divorce! 

But she is married to Duke Sylvester Lizen, who genuinely seems fond of her and lets her do anything her heart desires — even if that's stalking the crown prince. 

Wanting to shed her wicked ways, Ophelia tries to turn over a new leaf, but how can she when Sylvester's one divorce condition is for her to seduce the crown prince who despises her?
___
When Ophelia Lizen awakens in the body of a doomed villainess fated to murder her husband, she wants only one thing: a divorce. Sent back before the tragedy unfolds, she plans to end her marriage quietly and vanish from the capital. But rumors brand her as the crown prince’s obsessive stalker, and her cold, calculating husband, Duke Sylvester Lizen, refuses to let her go. Now trapped between a prince who despises her and a husband who won’t release her, Ophelia’s only way out may be through the very game she swore to avoid: seduce the crown prince to win the favor of her villainous husband.

A slow-burn romantic fantasy about a villainous couple bound by fate, torn by pride, and far too stubborn to realize they might just be in love.
description.fr: Je suis devenue Ophelia Regen, la méchante dans un roman à l'eau de rose de mauvaise qualité. Avant de tomber dans les pièges des protagonistes et de connaître une fin pathétique, je veux vite divorcer du mari d'Ophelia, Silvestre Regen, et retrouver ma liberté. Mais les conditions qu'il a posées sont ridicules. « Ophelia, voulez-vous divorcer ? Alors essayez de séduire le prince héritier. » Comment suis-je censée le charmer alors que l'héroïne originale est juste là ? En plus, dans l'histoire originale, Ophelia finit par être tuée par lui ! Mais je dois quand même réussir, pour obtenir mon divorce ! Comment vais-je séduire un prince héritier qui me déteste plus que tout ?
description.id: Dia merasuki wanita jahat yang mencintai pemeran utama dan membunuh suaminya. Untungnya, alur ceritanya sebelum dia membunuh suaminya. Dan sayangnya, semua orang tahu dia sangat mencintai pemeran utama pria. Dalam kasus ini, dia harus bercerai secepatnya. Tapi kenapa… “Gila, gila, gila. Aku baru mendengarnya. Aku tidak tahu itu gila,” kata suamiku sambil merobek-robek surat cerai yang kuberikan padanya. “Aku tidak bisa menahannya. Aku tidak punya pilihan selain hidup dengan wanita gila.” Tidak, kamu punya pilihan? Kenapa aku tidak bisa bercerai?
description.ko:
목표는 이혼, 조건은 유혹?
막장 치정 로맨스 소설 속 악녀 '오필리아 리젠'으로 빙의한 나.
주인공들의 계략에 놀아나 비참한 최후를 맞이하기 전에
하루빨리 오필리아의 남편 '실베스터 리젠'과 이혼하고 광명을 찾고 싶은데,
남편 놈이 내건 조건이 가관이다.

“오필리아, 이혼이 하고 싶어? 황태자를 네 것으로 만들어 봐.”

원작 여주가 버젓이 있는데 남주를 무슨 수로 꼬셔!
게다가 원작에서 오필리아는 걔한테 죽는다고!

그래도 해내야 한다, 나의 성공적인 이혼을 위해!
날 똥파리보다 싫어하는 황태자, 무슨 수로 유혹해야 할까?
description.pl: Po przebudzeniu się w środku lasu, podczas deszczowej nocy — i to w ciele złoczyńczyni z powieści — Ophelia Lizen pragnie tylko jednego... rozwodu! Problem w tym, że jej mężem jest książę Sylvester Lizen, który najwyraźniej naprawdę ją kocha i pozwala jej robić, co tylko zechce — nawet jeśli oznacza to śledzenie następcy tronu. Zdeterminowana, by porzucić swoje niegodziwe nawyki i zacząć wszystko od nowa, Ophelia próbuje zmienić swoje życie. Ale jak ma to zrobić, skoro jedynym warunkiem Sylvestera na rozwód jest... uwiedzenie księcia, który jej nienawidzi?
description.ru:
Я открыла глаза и оказалась злодейкой, безумно влюбленной в главного героя и которой суждено было убить собственного мужа. К счастью, я попала в ее тело до того, как она совершила преступление. Правда вот все уже знают об ее одержимой любви к главному герою. Итак, мой главный приоритет — как можно скорее развестись с мужем и избежать мрачной участи.

Но тогда…

«Ты сумасшедшая, действительно сумасшедшая. До меня доходили слухи, но я не осознавал, насколько все плохо», — пробормотал мой муж, разрывая документы о разводе, которые я ему вручила.

«Похоже, у меня сумасшедшая жена», — добавил он с ухмылкой.

Подожди, что?! Почему я не могу развестись?!

description.en:
As a member of the "Nine Road" for decades, I've traveled the world preventing global catastrophes. My long-awaited retirement was finally within reach. At 56 years old, what awaited me was the fame of being a battle-hardened veteran who had reached the highest EX rank, and countless accolades as humanity's hero and Earth's guardian! All that was left was to truly enjoy a life of wealth and glory! 

And just as I was about to settle into a comfortable retirement... I woke up to find myself as my 24-year-old self from 32 years ago! Even worse, I'm back in the past when I had absolutely nothing!

description.en:
She was possessed by a book without knowing what novel it was. Then, one day, her fiance appeared. ‘Killian’ was a perfect Northern Duke with black hair, red eyes, and a handsome face. It was a contract marriage. ‘I can see that person is the male protagonist even if I rolled backwards…’
So, Sophia believed without a doubt. She thought he would be the male protagonist. But…
“Ah, I got caught.”
The smell of blood came on the tip of her nose. Killian’s eyes narrowed. Then she realized the fact that he was a villain.And a cold hand caressed her cheek.
“There won’t be a breakup, Sophie.”
Raising the corners of his lips slightly, he whispered softly. ‘I think this is also a cliché… I hate that cliché!’

This story, which has been passed down for a long time, is a story from heaven. A long, long time ago, there were six rulers in Heaven. Each ruler had their own role to perform for the harmony of the world.  
  
The Ruler of Darkness had the power to draw anything and erase anything. The Ruler of Light knitted light to shine on the Earth. The Ruler of Flames danced to create eternal flames. The Ruler of Water brewed alchohol and showered water on the Earth. The Ruler of the Earth plowed the fields to enrich everything. The Ruler of the Wind played the flute to the generate winds.  
  
Each of the rulers had supreme power, yet they could not do everything themselves. Therefore each of the rulers had many spirits as servants. Amongst these servants, those with superior talents became the beloved sons & daughters of the rulers. This story is about the son of the Ruler of the Wind, GYON-WOO. And the daughter of the Ruler of Light, JIK-NYU.

One day, The son of God came to the school. Her name is Go Deung Shin.
Since her arrival, Go Deung Shin has shown many miracles, such as raising a sitting person, knocking down the school’s bully, reviving the dead and other such miracles.

And Bae Du Hong, a loser at school was reborn by Go Deung Shin and fights as the first apostle to prove the miracles of Go Deung Shin.
But is she, or is he really the son of God? Or…

"Common features, the illegitimate child of a self-proclaimed author."
 
Leona, a maid who rose to power with her exceptional intelligence despite lacking a prestigious background.
 
But when the empire, which she thought would be eternal, crumbled under the enemy's invasion, she too met her death by the enemy's sword.
 
A life filled with greed, harming others, and engaging in cunning schemes.
Her life was filled with regret, so death was welcome...
 
But she returned.
Back to the time when she first entered the palace as a maid.
 
This is definitely a chance to correct the mistakes of her past life.
 
"This time, I will live a life of protecting and nurturing, not harming and taking from others."
 
Choosing the Crown Prince, her political enemy from her past life whom she had dethroned, as the key to changing this life, she served as a maid, and everything seemed to be going well...
 
"Leona, let's leave this place together."
 
Something seems wrong.
 
The secrets of the Crown Prince, who she thought was cold and indifferent, and the truth hidden from the world are revealed, and the shadow of destruction falls upon the empire.

(Source: MangaUpdates)

description.fr:
Si vous formez cent mille guerriers aux arts martiaux, l'un d'eux finira par devenir un véritable démon de l'épée.

Un être qui ne se soucie ni des techniques, ni du niveau d'énergie interne, ni de l'expérience accumulée.

Un être qui n'a que pour seule but de trancher quiconque se tenant face à lui.

Cet être, c'est Heon.

description.fr:
Une étudiante modèle et perfectionniste qui croyait que l'amour était un luxe voit son coeur vaciller lorsque quatre choix s'offre à elle.

Est-ce vraiment une bonne chose ?

description.en:
Sanghyeon has the uncanny ability to absorb powers of magical artifacts — by devouring them. But it took him thirty years to master, and at fifty-five, it’s too late to escape mediocrity. 

Then one day, he’s miraculously sent back in time to the fateful day he awakened his powers as a monster-hunting player. 

With a chance for a do-over, he wastes no time using his ability to its full potential, rapidly absorbing incredible powers and rising through the ranks, determined to become the hero he always dreamed of being.

However, he, who was (literally) intoxicated by his high status, behaved recklessly and caused a major accident, completely shaving off the Jade Emperor’s hair. Enraged, the Jade Emperor banished him to the Mortal Realm. After falling into the Mortal Realm, Jinyul planned to regain his prowess and return to the Immortal Realm once again. But the moment he landed, things started going awry! Can Jinyul regain his status and return to his rightful place in the Immortal Realm?

He joins a band with the blonde hair, blue-eyed Simon and the two go on to create their own “dark heaven” in an abandoned church. description.en:
A boy named 'Hyunsung', who was denying reality while suffering from school violence, gets into a traffic accident while saving a child on his way home and is summoned to another world. Summoned to the other world he had longed for, his excitement is short-lived as he is immediately sentenced to execution without understanding why.

Unjustly killed, Hyunsung does not die but returns to reality, waking up in a hospital. Just when he thought he had returned to his normal life, unidentified monsters begin indiscriminately killing people in front of Hyunsung. An otherworlder, possessing the body of a bully, claims to be a hero. Before Hyunsung can fully grasp the situation, he finds himself needing to save the world. Can Hyunsung defeat the Demon King and restore the original world?

After striking up a conversation with a mascot-costumed part-timer at a flower shop, Dohee ends up on the bad side of the school delinquent, Yang Hyun! He starts confiding his true feelings to the mascot… but it turns out the one inside the costume is actually Yang Hyun?!

But the greatest secret of all is that Abel’s resurrected body is now occupied by Belial, the seventh king of hell, who has come to slowly plague the land...
A world where machines yearn to understand and become humans and where one human seeks to become as strong and indestructible as these machines. A jam-packed action SF that will blow your mind away.

Now, the only way for Moojin to cure himself is by working with the ones he hoped to avoid the most... the vagrants.

Ghosts aren't real... right? Gongchan has a wild imagination as a horror-novel author with a knack for turning his mundane life into a harrowing ghost story. These spooks live only in his head... that is, until he meets Youngmin, a man haunted by the supernatural spectres in Gongchan’s novel! Suh Hyun-bin grew up under the cruel hand of street gangsters, but after her little brother dies, Hyun-bin runs away and is taken in by a rich family to be trained to become a bodyguard. However, she must hide that she is female, and pose as a man. And so, for eight years, she grows up as a cold, male, bodyguard. It looks like she'll be this way forever–until a fateful encounter with Lee Yun-ha shakes her very foundations, and leaves her conflicting with herself, as her feelings of love clash against her feelings of duty.

description.en: On the day of her unhappy engagement, Rayalexis Reanello is magically teleported from the misogynistic Ridam Empire to modern-day Korea. There, she enjoys 10 years of friendship and independence. But on her best friend’s birthday, Rayalexis is mysteriously transported back to her home world, where only a single day has passed. With a newfound yearning for freedom, she dumps her loser fiancé and resolves to pave her own way… until the “angel of high society,” Duke Louivan, suddenly proposes a marriage contract! Will Rayalexis succeed in bringing modern sensibility to this old-fashioned empire while surviving a year with this man?
description.es: En la conservadora Lidam, es impensable que una mujer de gran linaje no se case. Leialexis Leannelle, la dócil hija mayor de la familia más poderosa de Labidan, la capital de Lidam, es transportada a otro mundo por un misterioso accidente. ¡A Corea del Sur! Sin embargo, de repente, después de diez años, regresa de la misma manera que cuando llegó a Corea del Sur. Una década de vida en Corea han cambiado sus valores, ahora sueña con vivir soltera, dejando atrás su entorno restrictivo para, ¡¡vivir bien y feliz por su cuenta!!
description.ko:
묘령의 여인이 결혼을 안 하는 것은 있을 수 없는 일인 보수적인 리담. 리담의 수도인 라비던의 제일가는 졸부 집안의 유순한 맏딸인 레이알렉시스 르아넬로는 모종의 사고로 이세계로 이동하게 된다. 바로 대한민국으로!
하지만 10년이 지난 어느 날, 대한민국에 왔을 때와 마찬가지로 너무나 갑작스레 다시 돌아와버린 리담. 10년간의 생활로 인해 가치관이 천지개벽한 레이는 꽉 막힌 주변을 제끼고 ’혼자 잘 먹고 잘 살기 위해‘ 독신을 꿈꾼다!!
description.pl: W dniu swoich nieszczęśliwych zaręczyn, Rayalexis Reanello została magicznie przetransportowana z mizoginistycznego Imperium Ridam do współczesnej Korei. Tam spędziła miło 10 lat wraz z jej przyjaciółką oraz niezależnością. Ale w dniu urodzin jej najlepszej przyjaciółki Rayalexis została z powrotem przetransportowana z powrotem do jej ojczyzny, gdzie nie minął nawet jeden dzień. Z nowo odkrytym pragnieniem wolności, zrywa zaręczyny i próbuje pójść własną ścieżką... dopóki "anioł wysokich sfer", Książe Luivan, nagle proponuje jej kontraktowe małżeństwo! Czy Rayalexis uda się wnieść współczesne wartości do tego staroświeckiego imperium, próbując przetrwać rok u boku tego męzczyzny?
description.ru:
Лавидон, столица Лидама, где для женщины-призрака немыслимо не выйти замуж.

Принцесса Лавидона - Рейалексис Линелло, послушная старшая дочь знатной семьи.

После несчастного случая она бросает своего жениха, как только приходит в себя.

"Ты... сошел с ума после смерти, Алекс?"

"Если тебе неприятно, что я тебя бросила, скажи ему, что я порвала с ним, потому что считаю его сумасшедшим".

Лежа в постели, она попробовала "другой мир" и проснулась с мечтой быть одинокой.

Она решила стать "женщиной, на которой никто не хочет жениться!

"Боже мой, как обидно! Наверное, поэтому ты и не можешь не быть рабыней".

"А кто из вас на самом деле дворянин? Женщинам рыцарские звания не дают".

Это был грандиозный банкет, устраиваемый раз в год, и Рей играла роль ведьмы Равидона.

"Рамиэль Руиван здесь!"

Сереброволосый, золотоглазый, статный, красивый, собирающийся вступить в герцогство в возрасте двадцати двух лет.

Вопли ведьмы стихли, когда появился человек, известный как Ангел Равидона.

"Молодец, Рейялексис, ты была сегодня очень непослушной. Теперь у тебя не будет даже собаки!"

Рей выскользнула на террасу и в одиночестве съела свой обед, похлопывая себя по спине.

"Пуф".

За спиной раздался смех, который никогда не должен был быть услышан.

Это был Рамиэль Руиван, "Ангел Равидона", который должен был находиться в центре банкета!

Через несколько дней после бегства из бального зала Рэй получает озадачивающего гостя.

"Я хочу жениться на юной леди".

"...Что?"

Рамиэль следует за ней домой и предлагает заключить брачный контракт!

Сможет ли Рейялексис исполнить свою мечту о беззаботном одиночестве?

description.en:
In a world where magic and might clash, Isoc dreams of becoming a wizard despite his muscular build. Raised by Father Kay, a priest who insists he become a fighter, Isoc faces constant pressure to follow a path he doesn't desire.

Desperate to pursue his magical aspirations, Isoc ventures into the treacherous Dark Forest. There, he's attacked and nearly killed by a curse-eaten monster. At the brink of death, he's saved by a mysterious figure known only as the Witch.

However, salvation comes at a price. The Witch, seeing potential in Isoc, forcefully binds him into a magical contract. "I'll give you a curse, so make a contract with me!" she declares, insisting that Isoc now owes her his life.

description.en:
Thelma and Louise were born as twin daughters of the famous Preteria family.
Among them, Thelma lived her whole life pretending to be a man, as her mother instructed. Even the sadness of her twin sister, Louise, who is neglected by her, is ultimately for our benefit. He also endured the position of marquis, which was not appropriate for his age... “Why don’t you just kill us when we were born and replace us with another boy?”

We learn that her mother, Gina, is planning to get rid of Thelma and establish her real man, the Marquis, through her sister's arranged marriage.
Just in time, a dragon, a being from the past, appeared before the twins who were cornered as a salvation. “Make a contract with me.”

You cannot make a contract with a dragon that was recorded as an enemy of the empire. but.... “Preteria. If you make a contract with me, I will kill your mother.” What is the intention of this dragon who makes an offer that is difficult to refuse?

The Aether Grand Library, also called the Holy Land of Books. There, the journey to find the prophecy that foretells the end of the world begins..  
  
Who is the master of fate?

Only a swordmaster can slay another. Arhan believed the tales of Liam Karavan, the founding father of his house, were nothing more than legend, until a deadly swordmaster slaughtered everyone dear to him. In his darkest hour, Liam comes to him as a guiding spirit, revealing the true power of their bloodline--the power to devour blades and inherit the strength and memories held within. With each sword consumed, Arhan draws one step closer to vengeance. To avenge his loved ones and restore House Karavan to its former glory, he must survive the perilous path to becoming a swordmaster.

title.en: I Picked Up a Lamp Today

description.en:
Kwak Chung is an orphan born in Chengdu who suffered from polio as a child and was disabled in one leg. He sold rice cakes to merchants returning from the West for a living while being ignored by all kinds of uncomfortable bodies, and one day on his way home, he accidentally picked up a lamp.

I rubbed it a few times because I thought it would make money if I sold it.
"I will grant you three wishes, my lord."
A wish-fulfilling Genie appeared.
"Are you sure you'll grant all your wishes?"

Kwak Chung's first wish is money, not just money, but also enormous wealth such as silver, gold, silk, and jewelry.

My second wish is to change into a tall, strong built, and a handsome and strong man.
And the third wish is...

"Let me go back to before I met you."

That's how Kwak Chung's infinite return journey begins!

description.fr: « Je n'ai besoin ni d'amour ni de reconnaissance. Ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est de pouvoir. ». Après avoir affronté la mort sans en comprendre les raisons, elle découvre les secrets de la mortalité. Alors qu'elle lutte, l'esprit de la mort apparaît aux côtés d'Azelda, lui offrant une nouvelle chance de vivre. Pour devenir un esprit redoutable dans sa quête de vengeance, elle se consacre à son entraînement. « Tu dois passer la nuit ici avec moi », insiste-t-elle. Faisant fi des sentiments, Azelda s'adresse d'abord à son mari, Seid, qui lui a tourné le dos dans leur quête commune de pouvoir et de vengeance.

description.en:
Reincarnated as a nameless commoner on Raniakea, the continent of magic and steel, with memories of 21st century Earth. To escape the life of a commoner, who is almost like a slave, he must lift the 'Magic Stone' and become a Giant Rider.

‘Straighten your back!’ ‘Tighten your belly!’ ‘Take a deep breath into the bottom of your abdomen!’. He uses knowledge from his previous life as a trainer to accumulate magical power as if he were exercising, and climbs the ladder of the social hierarchy.

“Marry me, Vivian.” She believed that she could have a happy future together with him. However, after he became emperor, everything started to change. His attitude suddenly changed. A strange rumor that he has an affair with a princess every night. In the end, I was confined to the imperial palace, and I only did what he told me to do. Then one day... “You are pregnant.”I don't need children.” What should I do, if I stay silent, I will lose my child.. I will protect my child even at the risk of my life! So Vivian decided to erase herself from everyone's memories and leave. “Stop it, forget me.”

There are times in our youth that are awkward, messy, and unforgettable that stay with us forever. In the heart of adolescence, this is the story of first love. 

Mingyu has quietly loved his childhood friend, Jiwoo, for as long as he can remember.
Every time she laughs, complains, or casually drifts closer, his feelings deepen slowly but surely. The problem? Jiwoo has always had a thing for a very specific type: big, muscular "beast-like" guys. That's the total opposite of Mingyu. Thankfully, she’s never seriously liked anyone in real life so Mingyu has stayed in his role as the dependable “guy friend,” standing loyally by her side. But one calm autumn day, his peaceful world is shattered. “Joo Mingyu… I think I’m in love.” Out of the blue, Jiwoo falls head over heels for Kang Taemin, the captain of the school volleyball team. Now faced with the terrifying possibility that this might be her first real love, Mingyu realizes: it’s do-or-die. Determined not to lose her, he sets out on a last-ditch mission to become her ideal type… even if it means becoming a swole “muscular man” overnight!

description.en:
My mother remarried and I had a younger brother. With a happy heart, I tried to be a family with my younger brother, Millian. No matter how badly he behaved, it didn't matter. Did my effort shine?

I'm relieved that we've gotten quite close. Millian left a letter and went to war. It's been five years since Millian went to war. [Millian, I'm going to see you this time.] Who knew my letter would end the five-year-long war?

"Now I'm not your brother anymore," Millian flashed a document which said that he had been expelled from the family, "Sister, don't laugh with other men, unless you want to make me a murderer."

Millian Edmore Rachel. No, now it's Millian Taylor. My younger brother returned as a man. It's sad that he's someone else right now, but what? He's going to be a husband? …But why am I so nervous? I shouldn't do this.
description.zh-hk:
雖然你要成為外人的話，我很傷心，但你要當我老公？

因為媽媽再婚，我有了一個弟弟，米利安·埃德莫爾。

別人都說他的眼睛泛著血色，但我卻覺得米利安的眼睛像紅寶石一樣美麗！

雖然他很難伺候，但他是我的弟弟！本來想要和他更親近一些。

但他卻去了戰場！離家五年後，回來的第一句話竟是要離開家族？ ！

“竟然對我以外的男人笑…誰讓你擅自相親的？ ”他為什麼這樣…？

但我是米利安的姐姐…可是為什麼會心動？這樣不可以啊…！ ！
